reviews.text: Your products are the best and your customer service is excellent.  The dental powder is a great product

Great, caring staff and a calming office atmosphere went a long way to help to get Daisy less anxious about her visit.

Great experience overall; we're very satisfied!

Thank you, everyone!
Dr. Ho was patient, thorough and compassionate in outlining our dog’s dental issues.

Great and quick service. Kept me updated through the pets procedure.  Very  attentive doctor, answered all my questions. Very friendly and professional staff members. My dogs left without distress and happy .

I’ve been bringing my dog here for about two years, and what made me switch was how thoughtful the team at Green Dog Dental is in everything they do. They are incredibly meticulous and always seem to be two steps ahead when it comes to my dog’s health. Their attention to detail and proactive approach give me complete confidence that my dog is receiving the best possible care.

Thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful that you chose Green Dog Dental & Wellness for your pet's care. Our team looks forward to seeing you and your furry family again soon!

This place is a scam. The doctors try to sell you as many unnecessary teeth extractions as possible. They do not have your dog's best interest in mind. Check your bill for added items and services you didn't ask for. I caught them adding an extra $100 for an extraction, when I asked about it, the doctor got pissed and I'm pretty sure she cut my dog's leash so I had to carry him to the car. Lastly, I'm speaking from experience and read all the similar reviews. They're an immoral teeth pulling mill. Notice how they don't even defend their negative reviews. In a pinch, if you're desperate, go ahead but if you can help it, AVOID THIS PLACE.
We appreciate Dr. Vartanian's help with consulting our dog. She followed up next day to ensure we understand the next steps in managing his diabetes.

TLDR: GET A SECOND OPINION BEFORE AGREEING TO ANY EXTRACTIONS!

this veterinary office mutilated my otherwise incredibly healthy ~6 year old dog.

she was on a regular 6 month professional cleaning schedule with green dog dental.

the first time i brought her in they extracted upwards of 10 teeth. i was upset but they told me she had severe dental issues & that this would prevent extractions & dental issues down the road. i reluctantly agreed.

she got her teeth cleaned about 6 months later and was able to do the non-anesthetic cleaning with no extractions.

a few weeks ago i took her in for her 3rd cleaning & they said they wanted to pull 13 of her teeth. i asked that they please not take all the teeth they were planning to even if they could be salvaged until her next cleaning in 6 months. i specifically said i did NOT want them to take her canines because they wanted to extract 2 of them. when i went to pick her up, they yanked every single tooth they said they were going to INCLUDING a canine. i was in shock & broke down in tears.

my pup is not even 6 & has 6 teeth now after the butchers at green dog dental. i am kicking myself for not saying no & going to another vet for a 2nd opinion.

i did go to a vet today & showed them the x rays i was provided by green dog & the map of the teeth that were extracted. the vet agreed that their approach was extremely aggressive & said he thought many of the teeth that they extracted were salvageable at least for a few more months to years.

green dog has been going back & forth with me for a couple weeks because i do feel that they committed malpractice in particular by removing my dog’s canine without my consent.

they are refusing to give me a refund, which honestly is the very least they could do after the pain & suffering they have caused my dog & myself. my dog’s quality of life is forever changed. she will never be able to eat anything remotely chewy or crunchy again & i will have to buy special, EXPENSIVE food for her for the rest of her life.

they know they messed up because they are trying to get me to sign a waiver in order to give me a measly $500 refund. & it’s basically an NDA not to tell people how awful they are. as if. $500 is an insult when i was charged nearly $5000 & they made a HUGE MISTAKE with lifelong repercussions.

& i know they make at least $1000 on every dog they have to put under anesthesia before any extractions, so their greed is truly sickening.

TAKE YOUR PET ANYWHERE ELSE! these people are evil and only care about money, not your pet’s health.
Awful at taking care of dogs

i have taken my pup here for 3 teeth cleanings and have become very skeptical about their level of care after my most recent visit.

the first time i took her in, they said they needed to extract A LOT of teeth. i was upset but wanted to be proactive, so i agreed to the procedure in order to prevent further dental issues down the road (or so i thought).

the 2nd time i went, they were able to do the non anesthetic teeth cleaning, so i took that as a good sign.

my most recent visit was traumatizing.. they said they had to take almost all of her remaining teeth. they called me & said they wanted to take one of her canines because it was a little loose and i said no. i asked that they preserve any tooth that they possibly could even if it would likely have to be removed down the line. when i went to pick her up, i found out that they extracted 13 teeth in total including the canine tooth that i asked them not to remove. she only has 6 teeth left. she is just 6 years old. i cried when i went to pick her up & was told this news.

these 3 visits were over the span of about 2 1/2 years.

i feel like ive made a big mistake trusting this vet with her dental care & i'm beating myself up about not getting another opinion. i had a small dog in the past with severe dental issues as well & they never had to remove so many teeth in such a short period of time with regular cleanings. i REALLY wish i would have gotten a second opinion, but they kind of trap you because by the time they call you to ask for permission to extract, your pet is under sedation & you're already $600 in the hole. again, i did ask them to save the canines & to keep as many teeth as possible, so i'm really angry & upset that they proceeded with so many extractions --particularly the canine tooth.

on top of that, my bill was $5000, which is astronomical compared to what most vets charge for cleanings & extractions. i feel like they are aggressively performing extractions even when you ask them to keep any salvageable teeth. i won't be returning to this vet. i have a lot of regrets in trusting them.
Green Dog is just the best! Caring and kind, communicative and trusting. Hiro and I had the best experience this morning. Thank you!

My geriatric puppy has stage 2 chronic kidney damage which made me believe that she will not be able to get her teeth fixed. I assumed my fur baby was going to live a painful/uncomfortable life for her remaining life since I as a pharmacist intern understood initiating anesthesia with this disease state is already have lots of challenging risks involved.

Amazingly, the doctors here made it possible to fix her teeth with heavy monitoring. The current veterinarian team < at this location> is superb. Their communication, empathy and understanding is on point. I entrusted my baby with them and she made it through this long day and is now resting at home.

Update: 2026 She made full recovery and is still with us.
She gained back her weight and has been running around.
Green Dog Dental was efficient, skillful, kind and made us feel that our pup was in expert hands.

DO NOT RECOMMEND. My dog went in for a dental procedure with Dr. Heather Rally (R-A-L-L-Y) and she never recovered. What was done was excessively aggressive over 23 teeth removed in one sitting, including a canine after I was persuaded it was necessary through fear-based explanations about infection and risk, even though this could have been approached conservatively. This applies to any dog, not just small ones. After the procedure, my dog suffered neurological decline, neck tilt, paralysis, and endured nearly two months of severe suffering. I would have cared for her even if she remained paralyzed, but the reason I ultimately had to put her down was because she began gasping for air. Watching your dog struggle to breathe crying in pain at 3 a.m. while you are completely helpless is a level of trauma I cannot put into words. Out of desperation to understand what was happening, I took her to a neurologist at a separate facility, and even then it was extremely difficult to obtain medical records from Dr. Rally’s office. I made multiple phone calls asking to speak directly with the doctor who performed this major procedure, and she never once called me back no follow-up, no explanation, no acknowledgment, and no apology. I felt avoided and dismissed. The situation became serious enough that the CEO of the clinic, Dr. Garcia, personally intervened, called me back, asked to see my dog, and attempted to resuscitate her after she crashed. I acknowledge his effort, but this was not free, and the financial cost was significant. I later sought a second opinion from a truly holistic veterinarian in Malibu with over 40 years of experience, who helped manage my dog’s pain and confirmed two major red flags: taking a dog to the back without examining them in front of the owner, and recommending extreme, aggressive treatment without full transparency. You would never allow this with a human child, and it should not be different because your family member has fur. I live with the remorse of not advocating harder and the trauma of sleepless nights, syringe feeding, carrying my dog, and watching her deteriorate day by day. It has nearly been a year, and the pain is still very real. A medical professional is supposed to do no harm. In my experience, that standard was not met. Please be careful, trust your gut, and ask hard questions before trusting this doctor with your beloved animal.
Very pro. My cat is doing very well so far. He needed quite a few teeth pulled.
Everyone is always great. The staff and the doctors at both the Van Nuys and Sherman Oaks locations are always helpful and respectful and kind

I had to call (8) times for my cat to confirm instructions . EIGHT. I also asked for an Rx on Chewy and they messed that up. So now TEN phone calls . They are aggressive in recommending teeth pulling even on older animals who are in danger of anesthesia . My 2 friends have had pets that passed due to their procedures . A hallucination of ineffective mess of an offices . The dental tech he was amazing . I am crying right now from frustration. Literally in tears
Terrible.  I’d never bring my dog here ever again.

The team here does a wonderful job. This is my third year bringing my French Bulldog to have his teeth cleaned and also for extractions. They take the utmost care. I highly recommend getting your dog's teeth examined and cared for here.

So grateful for the amazing care at Green Dog Dental & Veterinary Center!
I took my dog here for a dental cleaning and check-up, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The whole team was super kind, gentle, and really made my dog feel comfortable the entire time. The clinic is clean, modern, and you can tell they truly care about pets, not just the business.

They explained everything clearly and gave great advice on keeping my dog’s teeth and gums healthy. My pup came out happy, clean, and smiling! If you’re looking for a trustworthy veterinary and dental clinic in Los Angeles, I highly recommend Green Dog Dental — they treat your pets like family!
Great experience that dental surgeon was fantastic. She was so gentle with my little Chihuahua who needed 14 teeth pulled, and Bambi's recovery was super fast. She bounced back after two days.

Absolute SCAM of a Vet.
My dog had UTI and they charged: $85 for exam, $110 for Urinalysis, $240 for Urine Culture, Cystocentesis $54 (they insisted even though I brought a sample of urine in) and finally $108 for a random antibiotic to try to treat the infection immediately. Grand total of $597.. for a UTI.  They said  the antibiotic might not end up being the correct one, but wanted to try to give my dog some immediate relief. They explicitly said "if it comes back as the wrong antibiotic we will get you a different one"

It took them almost FOUR WEEKS to get my culture results back to me (test was ran 7/9, they emailed me the results 8/4). They confirmed e-coli was present and asked how my dog was doing. My dog was still exhibiting symptoms and they had the audacity to say I needed to come back and repay for everything since a month had passed from the test.

Excuse me? It's not my fault they took almost 4 weeks to get back to me on the results- they told me it would take up to 7 days and due to their internal issues, they're now saying too much time has passed to use the same test results. Because of this, they're wanting another $400-500 for testing... FOR. THE. SAME. CONDITION. THAT. THEY. FAILED. TO. TREAT. This vet is trying to squeeze over $1000 from me to treat a single, common UTI and it is actual INSANITY. Vet services are notoriously expensive, but I've now called 4 other local vets that all said that this is not normal pricing or procedure.

Please, please call around and get quotes from other places because the next place I called quoted approx $200 for a urinalysis PLUS culture... something that Green Dog charged me $350 for.

This review is a long time in the making. TLDR: My dog got a terrible infection from a procedure here and they denied it was from them. They also might be pulling teeth unnecessarily. GO SOMEWHERE ELSE.

We started taking our dog there in 2018. He was a 5 year old rescue. They recommended removing a bunch of teeth. We agreed. He then developed a terrible abscess in his leg from the IV.

The last time we took him there was last year for a cleaning. They recommended pulling a bunch more teeth. We hesitated because at this point he was 11 years old. They gave us the hard sell and we agreed to go through it.

When we picked him up they said, "Oh we only did half of the teeth." At no point did they ever tell us they were only going to do half. We did not want to put him under again.

A week after the surgery, he developed a terrible infection in his nose. It was an abscess that ruptured and we took him back. The vet said "he was fine and something probably poked him in the nose." They denied it could have been from the dental procedure.

Well, his infection got worse, not better. It got to the point where he could barely breathe. We took him to another vet who helped finally get it under control.

We are terrible disappointed with this place. We think now they did not need to pull the teeth they did. They also never accepted responsibility for any infections he got from their procedures. I would never go back if you paid me.

We took our dog BooBoo in to see if he needed a teeth cleaning yesterday, among other issues, and were so pleased to receive more of the same honest advice that we've come to expect from Green Dog Dental. After the exam Dr Geist told us that my almost daily brushing had been working well as BooBoo's teeth looked very good and we could wait awhile to get them cleaned. The same thing happened over a year ago which allowed us to wait awhile longer before diving into the cleaning. Considering how many times we've received dishonest advice over the years from numerous veterinarians in the valley, that's a great relief to us as we try to do our best to do the right thing for BooBoo's health and our financial health. We also discussed BooBoo's thyroid issue with him and the advice was again solid and highly honest leaving us no doubt that he cared more about BooBoo's health than on the clinic making money from our  situation. The front desk is friendly and efficient, both on the phone and in person, and Dr Geist is an exceptional Veterinarian with specialized intensive training in internal medicine. He also has great integrity and honesty which is a rare gift in our experience.

The perfect furry patient
In no hurry to get better.
Smiling cash-hungry vet
Counting cash without regret.
Come on in, don’t miss your chance —
Prices fair at first glance.
We’ll fix your furry friend —
The perfect furry patient.

We’re sorry to hear you had a negative experience. We couldn’t find your visit in our records, but we’d like to understand more and help resolve any issues. Please reach out to us directly when you have a chance.
Thank you.

I finally found a wonderful veterinary clinic for my three dogs!  I fell in love as soon as I walked into their office.  The staffed greeted us like very warmly and enthusiastically and assisted us to a very nice, private waiting room.  They immediately made my dogs and I feel welcomed and comfortable.  I was there to get dental exams and a cleaning for my babies, and they magically made it happen!  My three very timid dogs got their teeth cleaned for the first time, and we all lived through the experience, thanks to the kindness and expertise of the vet and his staff!  I couldn't have had a better experience.  The staff were all exceptional and made every part of the process a breeze.  Making an appointment was easy with their online appointment making system.  They even retrieved my dog's old medical records.  I highly recommend Green Dog Dental & Wellness!  My first visit was a wonderful experience.

The best! I flew in from the east coast to come here again. Used to live in Los Angeles and took my dogs. They were the first to notice mild heart murmurs on both of them. Thank you GDD for providing such an amazing and much needed service for our most beloved and deserving fur babies.

Dr. Geist is a wonderful and kind vet. The office is clean and welcoming and the staff were all super helpful and understanding of both nervous pets and nervous owners. Pricing is very reasonable as well. This was the best experience with dental cleaning I’ve had and my dog left the office without having any drugs or anesthesia and was happily eating his lunch 30 minutes later.

Our overall experience from start to finish with the Sherman Oaks location was effortless. The staff was professional and extremely caring with our dog.  I highly recommend the facility to anyone needing veterinary care.
We had a very good experience.

Green Dog Dental = Elite.

DARLINGS......
Let me be perfectly clear:
I don’t trust anyone with my dog, Paulo Walo III... This is a canine who’s rejected stylists, side-eyed celebrities, and growled at more assistants than I care to admit.

But the moment he met the doctor at Green Dog Dental in Sherman Oaks?
He. Was. Obsessed.

I nearly wept.

The staff? Impeccable. Warm. Polished. So understanding—even when we were discussing treatment plans that cost more than my vintage Hermès clutch. No guilt. No pressure. Just total class.

And the doctor? Please.
Dr. Dreamy with a DVM.
Paulo, who trusts NO ONE, was basically purring in his arms. (Okay, not purring, but you get the idea.)

We left more relaxed than after a lakeside stroll with Buffy, his Cavapoo confidante from Bel Air.

This is pet care for the chic and discerning.
Paulo Walo the III.... approves. And trust me—he does not approve of much.....
Excellent service. Answered all my questions. They were kind and patient with my doggo. In and out in less than 2 hours. Doggo's teeth went from garbage to sparkling!

We’ve been clients at Green Dog since it was solely just a mobile pet truck run by Dr. Garcia , and the way they’ve expanded over the past decade alone has been remarkable. The new full service facility on Aetna street is nothing short of incredible - it’s beautiful and spacious, and staffed with the best people around. Whenever we take our dog and cat there, we know we’re in good hands, and quite often they fit us in same day, which is such a life saver! If you live in the area, make them your go-to for animal care, you will not be disappointed!
Great experience! Took great care of my baby and explained everything in details!
Hi Niza! Thank you for your 5 star review!

This was the best experience with the veterinarian we've ever had! Our dogs are terrified of other people and especially the vet, and this was a wonderful experience for everyone! Their staff is amazing and their fees are very competitive. Highly recommend!

Amazing. My dog had a Monday morning appointment and all in all the overall experience was so much better than I expected. The clinic sends forms a day or so prior to your appointment to let you know what to expect, as well as your dog's behavior and other necessary medical tidbits they need to ask of you. Instructions were easy to follow and the location wasn't far from my house at all, it's central to Sherman Oaks right off of Ventura Blvd. Be aware that they are located on the second floor of the strip mall, as I had taken a minute to figure it out when we first arrived.
Upon arrival, you're immediately greeted by the staff and once ready put into one of their waiting rooms to go over the preliminary paperwork you sent prior to go over any additional details. The room was warm, spacious and inviting! After the pre-evaluation, they took my pet to the back clinic for the exam and said they would call within an hour or so to let me know if they will proceed with the cleaning (they must determine first if your pet is the right candidate for non-anesthetic cleaning. And the exam is about $85). Once they determine that, they immediately contact you to say they've started the cleaning, then just as quickly, your pet is available for pickup. And sure enough, it a bit over an hour for the whole event. When you arrive, you're back in a room to go over details with the vet, then you checkout and get your furry friend back with teeth nice and clean!
I much prefer this method over standard procedure of having to fully sedate your pet in order for their teeth to be cleaned. So many complication IMO especially for older pets. Found a new spot!
Appreciate the friendly front staff.

Recommended by a few acquaintances. I was concerned about a potential exposure for my two dogs Star and Mister. Sarah with Green Dog promptly scheduled me a first time appointment like a breeze. Dr. Stephen Moffitt, DVM did a thorough examination and did his best to make my dogs feel as comfortable as possible (me too!). He took the time to explain he understood my concerns and what his medical opinion was and provided a medical explanation which I appreciated and suggested what is necessary for their health and wellbeing. I felt confident he had their best interest at heart and mind. He didn't try to take my wallet to the cleaners, (he actually saved me from myself over my deep concerns). He will now be Star and Mister's veterinarian. I highly recommend him for your beloved pet and your peace of mind too!

I paid $85 just to have my dog ​​looked at. The request was to remove tartar from 2 teeth, the dog is 3 years old, in the end the doctor brought a photo of another dog's teeth (an old poodle of another patient with loose front teeth) and advised to remove 8 teeth from my dog ​​🫠 It's a shame that this clinic is determined to cripple an animal for the sake of making money, as soon as I made it clear that I was not going to remove a bunch of teeth for my dog, the unkempt-looking doctor began to nervously reproach me for not trusting him, and that in the photo was my dog ​​(there were all kinds of dogs, including mine), but the front teeth that were loose were twice as big as my dog's.
Hello! Thank you for your 5 star review of our practice!

Everybody very clearly explains everything and obtains consent for all exams and procedures. They let people participate in shared decision-making and I don't feel like I am being pressured to do things or being up charged as is frequently the case at most vets in my area, especially when it comes to dental care. I like that they specialize in dental procedures here and have a lot of experience doing these types of interventions.

First time taking my dog for dental check up here. The service was great!! The ladies in front desk were very helpful and DR was patient and professional. Very affordable. I have recomended this place already. Thank you guys.

I have nothing but amazing things to say about Green dog. Every vet I've seen at this practice has provided a level of care, concern, and treatment that are unmatched by every other vet I have been to. I cannot recommend this place more highly. It's an amazing feeling to know that my furry friend is being taken care of with such thorough treatment. Additionally, the vet calling me directly to discuss treatment options and next steps was so comforting.
Very friendly and communicative! Treated my pup with lots of love and care
Hi Elias! Thank you for your 5 star review!
It’s always an amazing experience at Green Dog. The staff is so caring and willing to address all concerns.

I love Green Dog Dental! They are so attentive and really talk through all your concerns with you. I never feel rushed and I feel like I finally found a Vet who cares. Both Dr. Rally and Dr. Moffitt are 10/10!

I found Green Dog online when I was told by my vet to pursue non-anesthetic dental care after a 3 year check up. It was easy to schedule an appointment online. I looked on a Friday and was able to get my dog in for Monday afternoon! The team was very responsive and upfront about expectations. Pricing was transparent and I was able to consent to everything I felt comfortable agreeing to. Parking in the lot was tricky by there were plenty of meters nearby.

They did an excellent job explaining the condition of my dog’s teeth and they were so clean after the treatment. His breath also was SIGNIFICANTLY better. I definitely recommend!

I can’t say enough good things about Green Dog and their incredible team! My golden retriever, Chief, needed all the necessary paperwork and health checks to ensure a smooth trip to Europe, and they made the entire process seamless and stress-free.

From the moment we walked in, they treated Chief with so much care and attention. They explained every step of the process, handled all the details with expertise, and made sure we had everything we needed for international travel. Their professionalism and dedication were evident at every stage, and their love for animals truly shines through.

Thanks to Green Dog, Chief’s trip to Europe went off without a hitch. If you’re looking for a vet who genuinely cares and goes above and beyond, I highly recommend them!

Still fairly new to this office but so far my experience has been great. Love the small rooms you wait in, so much more welcoming than other vet offices. The padded benches help my dog have space to lay next to me which keeps her calm because she gets extremely anxious. Every doctor I've spoken with takes the time to answer my many questions and I don't feel rushed, they always make sure things are answered. They also give me a lot of options so I'm well-informed since these decisions can be huge when dealing with cancer. I hope their doctors stick around for a long time, it's been hard to find consistency for us.
My only wish is that they were able to get things pre-approved with Trupanion instead of paying upfront. But that doesn't make them any less amazing for the communication, customer service and comfort that we have seen thus far.

Dishonest and unethical. They use scare tactics to convince you into opting for costly diagnostic services. There are so many reports of owners being told their pet has a heart murmur in order to squeeze money out of them. They tried it with me as well. Absolutely cannot recommend. It’s a total money grab.

Green dog dental was amazing! It was my first time there and I was nervous because my dog gets really anxious and usually doesn't open her mouth at the vet, but they were so kind and made my dog feel so comfortable that it was a miracle she ended up being able to get her teeth cleaned without a mild twilight sedation, which I was expecting she would need so I was so surprised and grateful that they made her feel comfortable enough and they did such a great job! The front desk was so nice and welcoming and Dr Mofitt was so knowledgeable, helpful and spoke with us for a while about our options and he was just awesome! I'd highly recommend green dog dental to anyone :)
Great docs and staff

This visit was amazing! From start to finish I felt myself and my dog were taken care of. Before the appointment I was told exactly how much it may cost and given very clear instructions on how to prepare Oliver for his dental cleaning. Dr. Ralley is exactly the type of Vet I want my dog with. She payed close attention to his needs and didn't push anything on us. Her approach completely aligns with mine. Figure out the root of the problem and work on that versus treating the symptoms. On our way out I was holding Oliver and he was still sedated. She kept looking at him and said "Oh Oliver" and giggled as she pet the top of his head", completely attuned to his needs. She gets a 10/10 from me. The office staff are all so friendly and caring as well. One woman went back and checked on him for me. The day after his appointment they texted me to see how he was feeling. I couldn't ask for a more caring place. I told the doctor "please don't go anywhere." She smiled.
Great experience at Green Dog Dental!! The staff is super nice and the vet was amazing! Very reasonable prices too!! Highly recommend

I can't express how satisfied I am as a customer. Since my dog had all her teeth removed, green dog was able to give my dog all well round services to support her quality of life. I am forever grateful for all of your services and support for my baby, Ms. Tiffany! You all are the best and I am so glad we have been loyal customers! Thank you thank you
We have had nothing but great experiences with the staff & vets at Green Dog Dental! Thank you
The most caring and knowledgeable team ever! Best choice I’ve made for my dog was to bring him to this team for all his needs.
Excellent staff and care. Highly recommend, especially for dental needs.

List of positives:
1. The staff were really sweet and professional.
2. The doctor made me feel like I could trust her judgement, as she was thorough, grounded and relaxed but also very considerate of my concerns.
3. My pet has recovered very well from surgery thus far and it was an extensive procedure requiring multiple extractions.
4. The meds were filled appropriately (not always a given!) and my cat’s pain seems to be managed extremely well.
5. I loved that I got updates throughout the procedure. It just seemed like my concerns were taken very seriously.
6. You get copies of your x-rays and well written care instructions (also not a given in my experience!)

10/10 recommend.

Ps: I had so much guilt putting my cat through this procedure but to see her coming out of it happy and healthy, I know it was the best decision for her.
My old vet doesn’t have non anesthetic teeth cleaning anymore so I switched to this one. I really like them as they are very efficient with the procedure and I don’t need to wait long for it.
Everyone including the VET was super nice and really listened to my concerns.

We couldn’t have chosen a better dentist for our cat. The staff made me feel so comfortable and safe and let me ask as many questions as I needed and they were SO informative. Many vets rush their appointments but Green dog really took their time to make sure I was on board with everything. They treated my cat so so well. Although dental surgeries can be pricey I’m so happy I chose this place and we will definitely be back when she’s due for her next cleaning. Also Dr Rally is amazing and a sweetheart.
Everyone here was so nice and thoughtful about my cat. She's going in for dental extractions this weekend. I'm nervous, but I know my fur daughter will be in good hands.
GREEN DOG VETERINARY CENTER IS THE BEST OF THE BEST WHEN IT COMES TO NON ANESTHETIC DENTAL CLEANING ! HAPPY DOG HAPPY LIFE ❤️‍🔥 …

I really like the comfy, non-hospital little rooms we get to go into so we don't have to all sit in the lobby with other anxious pets. My dog was well taken care of and she was happy when she came back to me. Staff was responsive to my questions and made follow up text as necessary after the surgery. Green Dog will become our regular vet now, as my dog wasnt trembling and fearful after her exam. That means she got some comfort from techs in the back. So awesome.
